name: Yoodli
what_it_is: AI speech coach that records/analyzes your speaking (filler words, pacing, eye contact) and offers roleplay scenarios for interviews, presentations, sales calls.
notes: Seed. Roleplay scenario library + game-like impromptu prompts; strong reference for AI feedback metrics.

name: Vocal Image
what_it_is: AI voice coach app generating personalized daily voice training plans: tone, pitch, articulation, confidence, accent, voice feminization/masculinization.
notes: Seed. Daily drill plans; app store screenshots show exercise types (breathing, pitch slides, tongue twisters).

name: Orai
what_it_is: AI public-speaking practice app with structured lessons; records speeches and gives feedback on pace, filler words, clarity, energy.
notes: Lesson-based curriculum with daily exercises; good model of gamified speaking drills.

name: Speeko
what_it_is: AI speech coach app with daily lessons, warm-ups and real-time voice feedback on tone, pacing, and delivery.
notes: Has skill 'courses' inside app; app store listing details exercise categories.

name: Ultraspeaking
what_it_is: Game-based public speaking training platform (Rapid Fire Analogies, Conductor, Triple Step) built by world-championship finalists; cohort coaching plus self-serve game app.
notes: Best-in-class example of speaking-as-games; game mechanics directly relevant to wit training. speaking.games is a free clone-ish resource.

name: VirtualSpeech
what_it_is: VR/web platform with courses plus AI-roleplay and VR simulations of audiences, interviews, networking events.
notes: Course catalog public; exercise = simulation scenarios with AI scoring.

name: Rejecto
what_it_is: Gamified rejection-therapy app: 100+ real-world social challenges escalating in difficulty, with a supportive community.
notes: Challenge ladder = real-world exposure exercise design; directly relevant to 'lower the stakes' ethos.
